page.title: 渡す型と to・for の分かれ道

analysis.summaryJa: SVOOの人→ものという授与型と、ものを先に置いてto/for＋人へ書き換える型を比較する。toは到達点、forは受益者を示し、cost/take/chargeのように人から時間・金銭等を奪う負の授与も同じ人→もの構造で捉える。
visualEvidence: 人→もの、to＝到達点、for＝その人のための3レール
文末の受け手を目立たせる書換え
commonTraps: toとforを交換可能と考える
SVOOで人とものを逆にする
costの人を目的格にしない
give系とmake/buy系の前置詞選択を混同する

questions.prompt: The coordinator sent the revised schedule ------- all participants.

choices.A: to
choices.B: for
choices.D: by

questions.translationJa: 調整担当者は改訂日程を全参加者へ送りました。
questions.explanationJa: scheduleがparticipantsへ届くので到達点を表すtoです。

questions.prompt: The assistant reserved a quiet room ------- the visiting auditors.

choices.A: to
choices.B: for
choices.D: at

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは訪問監査員のために静かな部屋を予約しました。
questions.explanationJa: 監査員の利益のために確保するのでforを使います。

questions.prompt: The hotel gave ------- a complimentary breakfast voucher.

choices.A: we
choices.B: our
choices.D: ours

questions.translationJa: ホテルは私たちに無料朝食券をくれました。
questions.explanationJa: SVOOの受け手位置には目的格usを置きます。

questions.prompt: The unexpected inspection cost the supplier ------- of production time.

choices.A: to two hours
choices.B: for two hours
choices.D: two hours

questions.translationJa: 予期しない検査によって仕入先は2時間の生産時間を失いました。
questions.explanationJa: cost＋人＋もの・時間で、人からその価値を奪う構造です。

questions.prompt: Please forward the signed agreement ------- our legal adviser by noon.

choices.A: to
choices.B: for
choices.D: of

questions.translationJa: 正午までに署名済み契約書を法務顧問へ転送してください。
questions.explanationJa: agreementの到達先を示すためtoを使います。

questions.prompt: The event team prepared extra name tags ------- late registrants.

choices.A: to
choices.B: for
choices.D: from

questions.translationJa: イベントチームは遅れて登録した人のために追加の名札を用意しました。
questions.explanationJa: beneficiaryを表すforが自然です。

questions.prompt: The delay took ------- nearly forty minutes of productive time.

choices.A: we
choices.B: our
choices.D: ours

questions.translationJa: その遅延で私たちは約40分の作業時間を失いました。
questions.explanationJa: take＋人＋時間の人の位置なので目的格usです。

questions.prompt: The chef made a separate vegetarian meal ------- the keynote speaker.

choices.A: to
choices.B: from
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: シェフは基調講演者のために別の菜食料理を作りました。
questions.explanationJa: 作る行為の受益者をforで示します。

questions.prompt: The billing error charged the customer ------- additional service fee that should have been waived.

choices.A: an
choices.B: to an
choices.D: was an

questions.translationJa: 請求ミスにより、免除されるはずだった追加サービス料が顧客に課されました。
questions.explanationJa: charge＋人＋金額・料金で負の授与を表せます。

questions.prompt: When rewriting “The clerk handed me the receipt” with the receipt first, the natural phrase is “handed the receipt ------- me.”

choices.A: for
choices.B: to
choices.D: of

questions.translationJa: receiptを先にする書換えではto meを使います。
questions.explanationJa: handの物は受け手へ物理的に届くためtoで到達点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct double-object sentence.

choices.A: The desk clerk gave me a room key.
choices.B: The desk clerk gave a room key me.
choices.C: The desk clerk gave to me a room key as SVOO.
choices.D: The desk clerk gave I a room key.

questions.translationJa: フロント係は私に部屋の鍵を渡しました。
questions.explanationJa: 人me→ものa room keyの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing the destination of a document.

choices.A: I mailed the document for Ms. Lee when she was the destination.
choices.B: I mailed Ms. Lee to the document.
choices.C: I mailed the document Ms. Lee without a preposition.
choices.D: I mailed the document to Ms. Lee.

questions.translationJa: 私は書類をリーさんへ郵送しました。
questions.explanationJa: 物documentを先に置き、到達点Ms. Leeをtoで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a beneficiary.

choices.A: We bought to our guest a ticket.
choices.B: We bought a ticket for our guest.
choices.C: We bought a ticket to our guest as beneficiary.
choices.D: We bought our guest to a ticket.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは来客のためにチケットを買いました。
questions.explanationJa: buyでは受益者をforで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative-transfer sentence.

choices.A: The mistake cost to us an hour.
choices.B: The mistake cost an hour us.
choices.C: The mistake cost us an hour.
choices.D: The mistake cost we an hour.

questions.translationJa: そのミスで私たちは1時間を失いました。
questions.explanationJa: cost＋人us＋時間an hourの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where “to” correctly marks an endpoint.

choices.A: The courier delivered the package to reception.
choices.B: The courier prepared the package to reception as beneficiary.
choices.C: The courier bought the package to reception as beneficiary.
choices.D: The courier saved the package to reception for its benefit.

questions.translationJa: 配達員は荷物を受付へ届けました。
questions.explanationJa: deliveryの到達点receptionをtoで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where “for” correctly marks a beneficiary.

choices.A: I sent a confirmation for the customer when it was delivered to them.
choices.B: I handed the form for the clerk as endpoint.
choices.C: I forwarded the email for the manager as endpoint.
choices.D: I saved a seat for the customer.

questions.translationJa: 私は顧客のために席を確保しました。
questions.explanationJa: 顧客が利益を受ける人なのでforです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct rewrite of “The company sent us the samples.”

choices.A: The company sent the samples for us.
choices.B: The company sent the samples to us.
choices.C: The company sent to the samples us.
choices.D: The company sent us to the samples.

questions.translationJa: 会社はサンプルを私たちへ送りました。
questions.explanationJa: sendは物を先にするとto＋受け手へ書き換えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct rewrite of “She made us some coffee.”

choices.A: She made some coffee to us.
choices.B: She made to us some coffee.
choices.C: She made some coffee for us.
choices.D: She made us for some coffee.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は私たちのためにコーヒーを淹れてくれました。
questions.explanationJa: makeの受益者は物を先にする場合forで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where the person loses something rather than receives a benefit.

choices.A: The cancellation cost the hotel thousands of dollars.
choices.B: The hotel sent guests coupons.
choices.D: The hotel offered guests breakfast.

questions.translationJa: キャンセルによりホテルは数千ドルを失いました。
questions.explanationJa: costは人・組織から価値を奪う負の移動を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the best analysis of “The repair took the technician two hours.”

choices.A: technician is the destination marked by to.
choices.B: two hours is a benefit prepared for technician.
choices.C: technician receives two hours as a gift.
choices.D: the repair consumes two hours from the technician's available time.

questions.translationJa: 修理は技術者の使える時間から2時間を消費しました。
questions.explanationJa: take＋人＋時間を負の授与として捉えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The agent sent me the ticket.”

choices.A: The ticket was sent to me by the agent.
choices.B: The ticket was prepared for me but not sent.
choices.C: I sent the agent the ticket.
choices.D: The agent cost me the ticket.

questions.translationJa: チケットは担当者から私へ送られました。
questions.explanationJa: meはticketの到達先です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We made our visitors lunch.”

choices.A: We delivered the visitors to lunch.
choices.B: We made lunch for our visitors.
choices.D: Lunch cost our visitors time.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは来訪者のために昼食を作りました。
questions.explanationJa: our visitorsは作る行為の受益者なのでforで書き換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The delay cost us thirty minutes.”

choices.A: We received thirty minutes from the delay.
choices.B: The delay sent thirty minutes to us.
choices.C: We lost thirty minutes because of the delay.
choices.D: We prepared thirty minutes for the delay.

questions.translationJa: 遅延のため私たちは30分を失いました。
questions.explanationJa: costは人から時間や金銭を奪う意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I forwarded the message to Ken.”

choices.A: I created the message for Ken but kept it.
choices.B: Ken forwarded me.
choices.D: Ken was the endpoint/recipient of the forwarded message.

questions.translationJa: ケンが転送メッセージの到達先でした。
questions.explanationJa: toは移動・伝達の到達点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “They reserved a table for us.”

choices.A: We were the beneficiaries of the table reservation.
choices.B: We were the physical destination of a moving table.
choices.C: We reserved a table for them.
choices.D: The table charged us.

questions.translationJa: 私たちがテーブル予約の利益を受ける人でした。
questions.explanationJa: forは行為の受益者を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The clerk handed her the badge.”

choices.A: She prepared the badge for the clerk.
choices.B: The clerk handed the badge to her.
choices.D: She handed the clerk the badge.

questions.translationJa: 店員はバッジを彼女へ手渡しました。
questions.explanationJa: hand＋人＋ものは、もの＋to＋人へ書き換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The fee charged me twenty dollars.”

choices.A: I received twenty dollars as a benefit.
choices.B: Twenty dollars was delivered to me.
choices.C: I had to give up/pay twenty dollars because of the fee.
choices.D: I prepared twenty dollars for someone else.

questions.translationJa: その料金のため私は20ドルを支払うことになりました。
questions.explanationJa: charge＋人＋金額は人から金銭を取る負の移動です。
